response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS hof_count FROM player AS p JOIN hall_of_fame AS h ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hof_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.hof_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hof_count > a.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: Representation means Hall of Fame records, including ballots for players who were not inducted; the state average includes states with at least one matched record.

alternatives.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.inducted = 'Y' THEN h.player_id END) AS hof_count FROM player AS p JOIN hall_of_fame AS h ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hof_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.hof_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hof_count > a.avg_count;

alternatives.interpretation: The average includes death-state groups with zero Hall of Fame records.
